title: バンブーメモリー登場！

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: (Looking at the morning sun always brings back memories…)

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: (Memories of that day… and what Dad taught me…)

text_block_list.name: Bamboo's Father
text_block_list.text: Listen up, Bamboo! Someday, you'll have a dream too!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo's Father
text_block_list.text: Your dream will be like the sun, giving you strength and courage when you need it most!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo's Father
text_block_list.text: The reason my rival and I were able to face each other time and time again was because we both had a dream that connected us!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo's Father
text_block_list.text: Your dream will help you grow and mature, bringing you some of your most precious encounters!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo's Father
text_block_list.text: But there's no rush! You don't need to figure it out now! You'll find it one day, and it'll hit you when you do!

text_block_list.name: Young Bamboo
text_block_list.text: Right! I'm gonna find my own dream one day, just like you!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo's Father
text_block_list.text: That's the spirit! Okay, break time's up! Time to get that blood pumping again with some more red-hot early morning training!

text_block_list.name: Young Bamboo
text_block_list.text: Yessir!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: (I'm finally doing it, Dad! I'm headed toward my dream!)

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: ALL RIGHT!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Time to get pumped up! Let's start off the day with some disciplinary committee work!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Burn bright, Bamboo Memory!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Bamboo Memory and I are finally ready to challenge the Twinkle Series in earnest!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I need to match Bamboo Memory's fighting spirit and passion if I'm going to walk beside her! I pep myself up and head to the academy.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: GOOOOOD MORNING!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Bamboo Memory greets the other students with a booming voice as they arrive at the academy! I guess this is part of her duties as a disciplinary committee member.

text_block_list.name: Younger Student
text_block_list.text: Good morning, Bamboo Memory!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: What a lovely greeting! Good morning to you too! Have a great day!

text_block_list.name: Younger Student
text_block_list.text: Thanks!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Hm… Hey, you! The one who just yawned! Your bow is askew!

text_block_list.name: Sleepy Student
text_block_list.text: Oof, sorry! I-I'll fix it right away!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: A lax outfit leads to a lax mentality! Straighten up your collar! Get fired up! Have a great day!

text_block_list.name: Sleepy Student
text_block_list.text: S-sure…
choice_data_list: You've been working hard since morning, huh?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Oh, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Good morning!
choice_data_list: Good morning!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Ooh, nice greeting, Trainer! I like it!
choice_data_list: What can I say? I'm feeling fired up.
What can I say? I'm feeling fired up.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Oh yeah?! Me too! Just thinking about all the exciting days in front of us until my debut has me feeling electrified!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: However! I'm going to stay on top of my disciplinary committee duties until training this afternoon! This is also important to me!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Since we're going to be walking this path together, it's best if I learn as much as I can about Bamboo Memory.
choice_data_list: While I'm here, can I shadow your disciplinary committee duties?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Huh? I mean, of course… but why out of the blue?
choice_data_list: I want to know more about you.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Hehe. That's kind of embarrassing, but I guess it makes sense! Take a good look and see what being on the disciplinary committee is all about!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, Bamboo Memory takes me through her disciplinary committee duties.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: You there! That's not where you recycle plastic bottles! Make sure you dispose of your waste properly!

text_block_list.name: Panicked Student
text_block_list.text: S-sorry! I'll be more careful!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Stop! Look where you're going when you're running! You need to be aware of your surroundings at all times!

text_block_list.name: Energetic Student
text_block_list.text: Y-you're right! Sorry!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Hey! This is a public space! If you're going to film something for UmaTok, please be careful!

text_block_list.name: Excited Student
text_block_list.text: Whoops! I'm so sorry!

text_block_list.name: Student Passerby A
text_block_list.text: Bamboo's at it again today. I've been on the other end of that once and her voice seemed so loud. I was terrified.

text_block_list.name: Student Passerby B
text_block_list.text: Yeah, but she's really nice and takes her job seriously. She'll always rush right over if you need her… even if she is a little loud.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: While accompanying Bamboo Memory on her rounds, I overhear some chatter about how she can be quite strict, but also very reliable.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I'm certain it's an impression built on her straightforward and ever-enthusiastic personality.
choice_data_list: (As her trainer, I should follow her example too.)
(As her trainer, I should follow her example too.)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Seeing Bamboo Memory so devoted to her disciplinary committee duties makes me want to meet her candor with sincerity and enthusiasm.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And now, it's time for our afternoon training.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Oooooh boy! It's finally time to start training! Let's do it, Trainer!
choice_data_list: We're going all out!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: YEAH!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: On that note… I know it's a bit early still, but is it okay if I go ahead and run for a bit?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: I've already warmed up, so I'll be okay! My body just won't stop tingling! Just one lap and I should be okay! Pleeease!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She seems quite motivated, and I don't want to discourage her by making her wait too long. So…
choice_data_list: Just one!
Just one!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Yesss! Thank you!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: I'll be back in a jiffy!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: YAAAAAH!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Bamboo Memory takes off with explosive acceleration. As expected, she's definitely got something special!

text_block_list.name: Student in Tracksuit A
text_block_list.text: Whoa! Isn't that the head of the disciplinary committee sprinting over there? Look at her go!

text_block_list.name: Student in Tracksuit B
text_block_list.text: Her voice is pretty impressive too! Seeing that kind of passion makes me feel like I've gotta go for it too!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Such tremendous leg strength… And she runs with such vitality as well.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: …I won't be outdone.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: I'm not finished yet! GRAAAAAH!
choice_data_list: What happened to just one lap?!
What happened to just one lap?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: In an unexpected turn of events, Bamboo Memory's training kicks off with a dead sprint under clear skies.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: And that's our first day DONE! Thanks, Trainer!
choice_data_list: Good job today!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Training just flew by! I can't believe it's already evening. Talk about a packed regimen…

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
choice_data_list: Bamboo?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: There's no doubt in my mind! One day, I'm gonna have the ultimate showdown with the ultimate rivals!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Hehe, sorry for startling you.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Anytime I see a beautiful sunset or a nice sunrise, I just wanna shout out my dreams!
choice_data_list: …It's a nice dream.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: …! Thank you!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Mark my words! I'm going to pour in my heart, soul, and whatever else is necessary to make this dream come true! Let's make it happen!
choice_data_list: Yeah! Let's do it!
Yeah! Let's do it!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Hehe!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Oh! I've got an idea! Why don't you try shouting your dreams at the sunset too?!
choice_data_list: Good thinking!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I gaze into the sunset, take a deep breath, and give voice to my feelings and my current dream…
choice_data_list: I'm going to make Bamboo Memory the strongest Umamusume ever!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: With Trainer by my side, I'm gonna become the strongest Umamusume! IT'S A PROMISE!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: My time spent taking on fiery challenges with Bamboo Memory starts now!
